The lower bound transfers from unit-weight hard instances and concerns any fixed constant approximation

results.bound: Õ(ε⁻⁴ log² Δ + ε⁻¹ log* n)
results.sourceLocation: Theorem 1.3, deterministic part (introduction); proof in Section 7
results.notes: General nonnegative edge weights; no weight-ratio parameter. Õ hides polylogarithmic factors under the source’s convention. The stated 1+ε approximation means retained weight at least 1/(1+ε).

results.bound: Õ(ε⁻³ log Δ + ε⁻³ log log n + ε⁻²(log log n)²)
results.sourceLocation: Theorem 1.3, randomized part; set δ=n^(−c), c>0 fixed
results.notes: The full theorem has ε⁻³ log Δ + ε⁻³ log log(1/δ) + ε⁻²(log log(1/δ))² inside Õ, with success at least 1−δ. This row chooses δ=n^(−c) for a fixed c>0. No dependence on weight ratio. Compact views abbreviate the last two terms as poly(ε⁻¹, log log n).

results.bound: Ω(min{log Δ / log log Δ, √(log n / log log n)})
results.guarantee: Any fixed constant-factor approximation to maximum weighted matching, by restriction to unit weights
results.sourceLocation: KMW Theorem 20 and Corollary 21; simultaneous min-form also stated in Harris Section 7
results.notes: Transfer: give weight 1 to every edge of a KMW hard instance. Then total matching weight equals matching cardinality, so a weighted constant-factor algorithm would solve the original unweighted task with unchanged rounds. This is an existence-of-hard-instances bound, not a claim for every graph or a tight dependence on ε. The simultaneous min-form is quoted explicitly in Harris Section 7.

Total memory is Õ(m+n), with ε fixed.
Probabilistic guarantee and theorem formulas are inherited from the existing full-text-verified MPC record.

parameters.epsilon: Fixed positive approximation parameter in the main figure

results.notes: d̄ is average degree. Theorem 5.1 states O(log log d̄ · exp(2^O(1/ε))) rounds and local Õ(n+poly(1/ε)) space. Local memory Õ(n), fixed ε; total memory Õ(m+n), fixed ε. Success ≥1−1/n^c for any constant c. No comparable lower bound is verified for this near-linear-memory contract. The reviewed CDP2024 conditional lower bound uses strongly sublinear local memory and is not plotted here.
